items.title: Financial Services and Trading LLM Applications
items.description: Chicago's financial markets — CME Group, CBOE, proprietary trading firms, banks — are active LLM adopters for internal analytics, research synthesis, and compliance functions. Research synthesis assistants: RAG systems over earnings transcripts, regulatory filings, and market research enabling analysts to query large document sets in natural language. Compliance communication review: LLM-powered first-pass screening of trader communications, reducing manual review burden while maintaining FINRA documentation requirements. Financial document Q&A: RAG over ISDA agreements, credit facilities, and derivative contracts enabling legal and compliance teams to query complex financial documentation. Regulatory change monitoring: LLM pipeline monitoring regulatory update feeds and flagging material changes requiring internal policy response. All Chicago financial LLM integrations include conversation logging for regulatory examination and output validation preventing specific financial advice generation in non-licensed contexts. Cost: $35,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks.
items.label: Financial Services

items.title: Healthcare LLM Applications
items.description: Northwestern, Rush, Advocate Aurora, and Chicago's health technology ecosystem use LLMs for clinical documentation, patient communication, and administrative efficiency: ambient clinical documentation (LLM converting physician-patient conversation audio to structured clinical notes, reducing documentation burden); clinical knowledge Q&A (RAG over clinical guidelines, formulary documents, and internal clinical pathways for point-of-care physician decision support); prior authorization drafting (LLM generating prior authorization narratives from clinical data, reducing the administrative time that prior auth documentation requires). All Chicago healthcare LLM integrations are HIPAA-compliant with BAA standard. Cost: $40,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Healthcare

items.title: Manufacturing and Logistics LLM Applications
